storyInfo: After crossing the front lines safely, Scioppa confesses to his squad that he is being coerced by Evgeny and explains his decision to resist. Rhodes Island witnesses the horrifying reality of the sealed district, and must decide whether to destroy the Sarcophagus or not. Crownslayer brings news to the crowd—An Infected 'factory' exists inside the city.

attributes.content: <p=1>Assault Ship Volnov, Command Center</><p=2> Jan 21, 1102, 14:42</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Approaching Second Army territory.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: Boss, should we keep our pace and press on?
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: Keep going.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: ...Hey, what if—
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Don't worry. We're through the front lines, so it's smooth sailing from here. You've heard him many times, haven't you? Always stops whenever we might hit back.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Kuznetsov's got a strange mind, but he's smart. Might treat us like trash, but he'd still use us until we're all used up before throwing us away.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Also, he cares for his reputation. Refusing to change his station to 'protect the north', marching outside Grypherburg without orders to 'suppress the rebellion'...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Letting his own warships be destroyed on the front lines during an armistice because of 'recklessness'? Doesn't sound reasonable at all.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Your astute and logical analysis would make one think you're close to him, even though we've only been serving Kuznetsov for barely two years.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: How can I feed you lot if I can't even manage to ask around about our superior?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Back on topic. Since we're safe now, we no longer have to worry about the Second Army coming after us.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: But their vanguard battalion is right there.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Oh, right. Send our identification code to their command center at once.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Did you only just remember to do that?!
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: I tried earlier, but we were out of range.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: —Bzzzzt—
attributes.name: Voice from the Speakers

attributes.content: Put it through to the speakers.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Re...
attributes.name: Voice from the Speakers

attributes.content: The signal can't possibly be this bad, when we're already this close?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: It is silent. Nothing comes through for several seconds—terrifying for those in the midst of war.
Everyone subconsciously straightens their backs as their breaths echo throughout the cabin.
If this is not a signal problem on the receiving end...
...Send it again.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: We already did.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: Should we switch to the contingency plan?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: We're too close for that. It's too late to fight them now, we couldn't do much.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Safety first. Go—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Received.
attributes.name: Voice from the Speakers

attributes.content: Identity verified.
attributes.name: Voice from the Speakers

attributes.content: Received.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: We will be gone in two hours.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: Phew.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Chief.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Huh... wuh? That's new. You've never called me that ever—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Come with me for a bit.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: 'Don't worry'? 'Smooth sailing'? Yebat ty, What's got you acting like a frightened little boy, then?
attributes.name: Oleg
Scioppa
attributes.content: It's different when I might drag everyone down with me.

attributes.name: Scioppa
attributes.content: Besides, that's was the past... I have no clue what deal he's done with the Second Army.
Perfect, because I rather not care about that now. What's important is whether you're going to tell the others or not.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: ...I didn't expect us to make it past the front lines, actually. I thought everyone would split and run off on their own, at which point it wouldn't matter.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Expectations and reality, completely different things. You'll have to tell them what you told me, unless you want them to die.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: I don't want to send anyone to their deaths.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Yourself included?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Do I look like I have a death wish?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Who knows? I wasn't the one who personally escorted Lieutenant Sirka ten miles away, claiming I only went for a walk.
attributes.name: Oleg
Scioppa
attributes.content: Alright, I won't die either. We good?

attributes.name: Scioppa
attributes.content: Let me think...
Chief, I'm serious. None of us are cowards. I think they deserve the truth.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: If this is your own mission, or even if it's just to save one of our comrades... I think the risk of death will be the least of their concerns.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: In any case, you should let them know.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: They'll be able to intercept a broadcast from the ship, so let's get everyone on the mid-deck first.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I'll think about how I should break the news.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: This must be the first time we've done so many meetings in a single day, and everyone's here too, even those on the night shift—
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: Shh. Just hear what the Boss has to say.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: It's definitely something important.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: The crowd instantly goes quiet.
Scioppa stands on a makeshift platform, composed of empty vodka crates stacked on top of each other. He manifests his Arts, quickly creating a soundproof space covering the entire deck.
He turns around, the light of his enchantment subtly flickering under the sun as it transmits his voice clearly to the crowd.
Listen up.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: First, I must apologize to you all.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: (Whisper) You hear that...? What for?
attributes.name: Soldier in the Back

attributes.content: I'm sorry for not telling you the true reason for this expedition.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I won't explain how I came to that decision, but as your commander, I am responsible for my decisions, and since my reason for hiding the truth no longer exists—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Boss, just tell us already. What is it?
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: The truth is... this time, Sechin has not voluntarily accepted the order to seize the First Army's new weapon.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: This is also, essentially, a suicide mission.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: He finishes with a deliberate pregnant pause to give the crowd time to process his words, expecting a wave of questions, but there is only silence.
Countless eyes look at him with the same expression. On the plains, on the battlefield, here and now, they have not changed.
Their trusting gazes seem to weigh down on him, and he suddenly realizes how tongue-tied he is now.
Making a speech, telling the truth—it now seems so arduous.
...So, that is why...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I swear to you...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: As he struggles to find the right words to say, he notices Oleg has moved.
Oleg is now next to the platform, and he pats the young man on the back with his large hands that used to knead dough daily, almost knocking his leader off the platform.
Hey—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Go on. Everyone's listening.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Say what you have to say, whatever it is.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: I took on this mission because the Fourth Army has information on the whereabouts of some of our old comrades who left us upon becoming Infected.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Just before we shipped out, Lieutenant Sirka was seized by Kuznetsov's men.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: —Lieutenant Sirka?
attributes.name: Soldier in the Back

attributes.content: I think she was a quiet one... that Sirka?
attributes.name: Soldier in the Back

attributes.content: We have to save her.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: Yeah, boss. Why don't we go rescue her right now?
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: That's the trouble. I don't even know where she is, I've only heard her voice over comms with Kuznetsov.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: So, our usual method of sneaking in, killing, rescuing, and getting out won't work here.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: So that only leaves me one path to take...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I'm not afraid to die. I'll ambush Evgeny and force Sirka's whereabouts from his dying breath! Maybe I can't do it alone, but I'm sure there are others willing to join me—
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: I know we can come up with a plan.
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: Count me in!
attributes.name: Excited Soldier

attributes.content: Me too!
attributes.name: Angry Soldier

attributes.content: The responses echo in the soundproof bubble. From the highest point on the deck, the man looks on as the cacophony of voices nearly take physical form, and shakes his head.
It's impossible. I know you're all more than willing to kill for this, but no.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Why?!
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: If I hadn't agreed to his demands, we'd never be able to save Sirka, and I couldn't protect the rest of you either.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: We can protect ourselves!
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: Could you protect yourselves from a whole unit of war casters?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: Before I decided to bring you all into the Fourth Army, I probed around and found out about a team, practically doing the same thing we do.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Kuznetsov's personal guard. A special task force composed of elite war casters.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: You mean... a whole unit as strong as you?
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: I'm nothing to them.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Leithanians use Infected as Arts units, but Ursus has researched the limits of using uninfected as casters, forcing them to use the tiny amounts of Originium within them as a catalyst.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: To reach their limit and to use the terrifying Arts units inside them, they endure the pain with drugs and body modifications, and this makes them adaptable to all sorts of combat scenarios.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: But this way, the Arts unit ends up consuming the user instead, turning their faces into a blur, their voices garbled.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: That's an easy way to contract Oripathy.
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: War casters can never be Infected, to keep the Ursine army pure.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Whether it happens accidentally or taking a shortcut, you can bet those Infected get tossed down some random mine shaft.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Those who survive and join the army... even a dozen, or just a few of them, have enough firepower to replace a whole division.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: That's how strong they are.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Even if you wouldn't usually set up a unit of just war casters, seeing as it would limit their battlefield adaptability.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I thought we had it good then, figured they were a safety net for us. But when we went against the Fourth Army...
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I finally understood how they came out of the Great Rebellion unscathed.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Fine! We can't beat them head-on or ambush them, so... what do we do? Sirka—
attributes.name: Rowdy Soldier

attributes.content: Don't worry, I won't leave her, or anyone else behind.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I just wanted to tell you all the truth, and then I have something to propose—or maybe I should say, a decision to announce.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: I will cut all communication with the base, and falsify the Volnov's location while I stop the ship's operation, for an hour.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: During this time, everyone is free to leave for nearby Volniki. Ultimately, this ship will function with a skeleton crew.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: We'll cut down on energy use as we continue to Zelgrad to secure the new weapon, which we'll use to negotiate with Kuznetsov and rescue Sirka.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Those willing to stay, throw your tags in the container.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: My brothers and sisters: when you chose to leave home, to join me with your passion and hope, I promised you this I wouldn't let anyone die in vain.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: We will not die like weeds, like fins, or fowlbeasts pulled, speared, or captured.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Because our lives have value. We are more than food for the monster we call war—
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: We must be free, and not only living the freedom granted by the worthies above.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: We have another choice beyond fighting or dying.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Ugh...
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Did you count all the votes?
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Here, take a look.
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: He hands over an open barrel of vodka—completely empty.
Scioppa stares at the darkness within and sighs.
Didn't think I was so unpopular that nobody would want to stay.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Come on! I'm sure you know what it means—no one here wants to leave, not a single soul!
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Who would even think of leaving after listening to the sentimental garbage that just came out of your mouth?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Well, some of them will have to leave anyway. The ship doesn't have enough fuel to operate at full speed or reach the satellite city in time.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Why don't you just tell everyone your plan to abandon the Volnov and go back to Kuznetsov to settle the score?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Because we should scatter our numbers to the Volniki, so Kuznetsov won't be able to catch all of us, if things go south.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: We can't put everyone in danger just to rescue Sirka, even if everyone's willing to throw their lives away.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Oh, so it's just gonna be me and you?
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: Come on now. You know most of them haven't spoken to Sirka even once. I can't expect the same of them as I do of us.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: Enough. Hand out supplies according to the list, and have them leave once the ship stops.
attributes.name: Scioppa

attributes.content: You stubborn—
attributes.name: Oleg

attributes.content: —Chief, incoming urgent transmission from command!
attributes.name: Composed Soldier

attributes.content: (Whisper) Closure isn't in here!
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Amiya, don't lean backwards, or you might fall off the truck! Hang onto the frame and shift towards the front.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: It's pitch-black here without the streetlights. All we've got is our headlights, but at least we shook our pursuers.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: But Closure—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.options: We can't turn back now...;Let's trust in her.
Closure will be fine until the military catches us all.;We need to move fast and find the Sarcophagus.

attributes.content: Car's stopped.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: <p=1>Zelgrad Sealed District, Underground Layer</><p=2> Jan 22, 1102, 03:21</>
attributes.name: group_location_stamp

attributes.content: Where... are we now? I think maybe we're underground—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: We are.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: How are you feeling, Raidian?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I stopped my Arts when we got near that wall, so I am fine now.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Say, Amiya. I did not notice until now, but there is an issue with this vehicle.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: There is an electrical signal from someone besides ourselves and the driver. It is messy, but I'm sure—
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: (Whisper) Wait, we have to hide!
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: (Whisper) Keep close to me!
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: You're late.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: (Shieldguards... what are they doing down here?)
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Sir, there was an explosion on the other side of the wall, and I don't know what caused it, but please, if you could just say I was on time... I have one more delivery to make...
attributes.name: Driver

attributes.content: The man in worker's clothing keeps taking out thin and round objects from his pockets, trying to stuff them into hands of the heavily armored soldiers.
His efforts bear no fruit as the discs silently roll to the ground.
You have broken the rules, so we no longer need you.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: Take him away.
attributes.name: Soldier
Driver
attributes.content: What?

attributes.name: Driver
attributes.content: No—NO!
I won't be late next time, I promise—
attributes.name: Driver

attributes.content: The remaining Shieldguard stands there for a moment before dialing into his communicator.
Cancel the alert.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: Have those below haul the goods away.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: Six floors underground.
attributes.name: Soldier

attributes.content: Hm, he left. If they've stationed heavy troops here, this probably means we're close to our target.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: If they're gonna get someone to haul the vehicle away, should we hide in the carriage?
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: We do not know where it might go, so we'd best find the way ourselves.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Raidian, you said you noticed another electrical signal on the vehicle...?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: ...Hold on...
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Not anymore.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: What? Really?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I would not lie to you. This might mean that the one I detected before has met with misfortune.
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: Mon3tr, can you open the door?
attributes.name: Raidian

attributes.content: It's harder than—
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: ...I thought...
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Neatly stacked fertilizer bags fail to conceal two human figures slumped on top of them.
One bears a frightening face, riddled with green scars and festering wounds, but the other has a peaceful expression, body covered in orange stones.
...! That patient—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: I'll go take a look.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.options: Is this the patient you were talking about before?

attributes.content: I think so. But it seems like his Oripathy has worsened.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: The density of the crystals on him too... it may be an acute infection, but to deteriorate this fast...?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Also, wasn't he—shouldn't he be at the clinic?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: He's dead, Amiya.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: For more than twelve hours at least, too.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: How? Wasn't there... a doctor?
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: As for the other... his symptoms look similar to the one you mentioned earlier.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: There are marks on his neck, and the bag was ripped open. Seems like he strangled himself, which is why no one outside heard him.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: ...I'm guessing the Doctor is asking why they're in a 'fertilizer truck'.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Because this place doesn't actually store fertilizer.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Mon3tr moves, and several bags burst open.
No fluids or particulates spill from the bag, only frozen and mutilated... limbs.
Dark yellow crystals encrust the surfaces—Perhaps they were stuffed into these waterproof fertilizer bags according to certain criteria.
No one wants to even consider what they might be.
How—
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Raidian steps in, blocking Amiya from looking on any further.
Mon3tr finishes checking the truck carriage interior, and stands up, closing her eyes briefly.
...Infected. All of them.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: Blood Originium-Crystal Density levels still climbing. This truck is practically a huge ticking time bomb—
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.options: Say no more, Mon3tr.;We get the idea, Mon3tr.
Come back here. Thanks for checking.

attributes.content: Amiya, the one with green bruise marks shares symptoms with those infected by airborne Originium dust caused by bio-energy disequilibrium after a Sarcophagus overload.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: However, you need loads of energy and extremely destructive usage to overload a Sarcophagus, so an accident like this is extremely unlikely.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: This may well mean that the Sarcophagus's basic functions have gone completely out of control.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.options: What are you saying?;That means... it's lost its restorative capabilities?

attributes.content: Doctor, I refuse to prepare for the worst.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: But my observations so far have indicated the bio-dust is still leaking from the Sarcophagus, with unthinkable consequences if we don't stop it soon.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: It could come to a point where we'll have to destroy the Sarcophagus to stop it from spreading further.
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.content: ...Although that would mean losing the chance to...
attributes.name: Mon3tr

attributes.options: Let's not assume we must sacrifice one for the other.

attributes.content: Right.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Let's press on, Doctor.
attributes.name: Amiya

attributes.content: Hey, you—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Ugh...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: If you can't stand, stay down.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Reunion... we've met before—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Oh, you're still here.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I'll skip asking how you know.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Are you really with Reunion?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Most certainly.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: How many of you are there? Can you help us? There's a weird sickness in the city that isn't Oripathy, and it's spreading!
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: We need to let everyone know, it's not a problem that will affect just a few—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: There's a few things I need to confirm with you. Can you describe its symptoms?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: It causes green bruises, and your skin slowly rots! My sister caught it, and I sent her to a clinic to 'isolate', but...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: She was taken away, somewhere I don't know. I heard people talking about how they saw soldiers loading Infected onto trucks and sending them to the wall...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Tulin quickly exchanges a glance with Red, as she continues hearing what Tonya has to say without interrupting.
The soldiers don't let us near the wall, but this time I really wanted to go, no matter what.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I was planning to follow a truck in, so I planted a bomb to distract them, and then I saw—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Tonya's eyes flick to and fro, and finally she looks at Closure.
You saw us?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Yes... I didn't know you, but I guessed we shared a similar goal. It was dangerous, so I just decided on the spot to help you...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Then I missed my chance... the gate's closed.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Wow, I really got to hand it to you.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: A plan like that... your bravery is commendable.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: We planned it properly and all, you know!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Um, thank you very much, for saving me...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Could I ask you all... to rescue... my sister...?
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: You said you followed the truck to the wall, but where did it come from?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: I don't know, I only realized it was heading towards the wall and followed it.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: So you don't actually know where your sister is.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: I—
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I'm sorry, we're willing to offer help to those who need it, but we can't recklessly throw ourselves into danger.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: We can't act without concrete information.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Please, hold on. What happened to this young lady's sister is probably not an isolated case in Zelgrad.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Do you have any idea where your sister might be?
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: You're right, I don't have anything solid...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I just thought... she fell sick because I was helping to wash the white coats of those behind the wall. So that's probably the one place they would take her.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: 'White coats', you say?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: I think they call them 'researchers', although I've never seen any of them in person. The guards never mention them either.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: They just go 'these are uniforms from Lab Six', 'these are from Test Lab One'...
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: Hah... it's like we're a laundromat.
attributes.name: Tonya

attributes.content: I understand.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: To be honest, we've also observed this 'strange sickness', and concluded that it was already killing the people here, regardless of where it came from.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: And based on what she's said, this is definitely because of an experiment they're running behind the wall...
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: —You mean that sickness is really related to the Sarcophagus?
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: What?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Uh—
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: So you came for the Chernobog Sarcophagus.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Hey, don't word it like we're just here for that!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Sorry, I didn't mean it that way.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: We can hear your story later.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: The pressing question now is: what is this 'Sarcophagus' you speak of? What kind of harm could it bring?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: It's hard to put together a quick and easy explanation, but as far as I know, it's capable of spreading infectious symptoms.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: It might not be the same as last time, but something similar did happen before, and just a few years ago too.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Right. All in all, you want to prevent a similar disaster from taking place?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: You could put it that way, yeah!
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Is the disaster triggered by this 'Sarcophagus' related to the Infected?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Based on the info we have at the moment, I can't draw any solid conclusions. I can only guess both Infected and non-Infected will be affected.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: We're already seeing signs, so we have to look further into it.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: Thanks for helping me today, but I'm still going to look for another way to find my friends.
attributes.name: Closure

attributes.content: We tried looking for traces of the refugee miners who came here, but haven't found anything. We haven't looked past the wall, though.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Likewise, we have our duty to fulfill.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Then, count me in too.
Hey, your wounds are serious. Careful how you move.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: I just knew... the First Army's secret weapon work was suspicious, I knew it would kill more civilians than soldiers before it was dropped onto some random battlefield.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: If you plan to cross that wall, then you should let me come with.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: You're an Ursine soldier?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Heh... have you ever seen an Ursine soldier fall as low as I have?
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: These Reunion people saved me, and I'm grateful.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Bring me along, and I swear you have an ally in me... I won't give up, even if you say no.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: I have a score to settle with a man in there... a man who should have died long ago.
attributes.name: Sirka

attributes.content: Uchitel! There's someone at the right entrance with an identification code requesting entry!
attributes.name: Nervous Student

attributes.content: It's a complete stranger, so we had her write the code on paper. Here.
attributes.name: Nervous Student

attributes.content: I don't know who this is. Don't let her in.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Seems like this place is no longer safe. We need to move as soon as we can.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Can I see the code?
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: This is an old Reunion code.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Someone from your side?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Everyone who followed me to Zelgrad is already here.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Anyone who shows up outside now...
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Talulah.
attributes.name: Red

attributes.content: Yeah, I know. I've heard of her operating in the west.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Let her in.
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: Her gaze instantly drops to Talulah, but quickly shifts away.

attributes.name: Tonya
attributes.content: You—you're the one who warned me!

attributes.name: Tonya
attributes.content: You said you were going to gather more evidence...
And I'm back with that evidence.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Lyudmila—
attributes.name: Talulah

attributes.content: I don't know what you were talking about, or your plans, but since you've been wandering around the city these past few days—
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: I take it you're looking for those missing Infected.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You know where they are?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: I even know of expansion plates in Zelgrad that aren't on any maps.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: On one of those is a factory, where most Infected are sent. As to what the factory is for, I have no clue myself.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: It's tightly guarded, so I came here looking for help, since there's no way I'll manage alone.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: You say those expansion plates aren't on the maps, but wouldn't the residents here notice all their Infected going to the same place?
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: When something doesn't concern them or those around them, it's hard for ordinary people to suss it out.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: After all, Zelgrad is the 'city of tomorrow' where every 'hardworking soul' can find their own place...
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: There is no need to worry about those left behind in the cold of winter when you bathe yourself in the warmth of spring.
attributes.name: Crownslayer

attributes.content: Regardless, saving as many people as we can is paramount. Before we go past the wall, we need to take a look at that 'factory'.
attributes.name: Tulin

attributes.content: Having a clear objective simplifies things for us... show us the way.
attributes.name: Tulin
